mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.doc_id, i.material_id, i.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, i.location_id, i.to_location_id, i.batch_no, i.production_date, i.expiry_date, i.qty, i.cost_price, i.biz_price, i.transfer_price, i.transfer_amount, i.serial_nos, i.remark, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, l.code AS location_code, tl.code AS to_location_code, b.production_date AS batch_production_date, b.expiry_date AS batch_expiry_date FROM wms_stock_doc_item i JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_batch b ON b.material_id = i.material_id AND b.batch_no = i.batch_no AND i.batch_no <> '' LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = COALESCE(i.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id) LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_location tl ON tl.id = i.to_location_id WHERE i.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_stock_doc_item (doc_id, material_id, warehouse_id, location_id, to_location_id, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, qty, cost_price, biz_price, transfer_price, transfer_amount, serial_nos, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.docId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.warehouseId}, #{i.locationId}, #{i.toLocationId}, #{i.batchNo}, #{i.productionDate}, #{i.expiryDate}, #{i.qty}, #{i.costPrice}, #{i.bizPrice}, #{i.transferPrice}, #{i.transferAmount}, #{i.serialNos}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_stock_doc_item SET cost_price = #{costPrice} WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND material_id = #{materialId}
